name: trio
description: Read balances, statements, Pix payments, receivables and corporate cards from your Trio account directly from Codex

interface.longDescription: Read balances, statements, Pix payments, receivables and corporate cards from your Trio account directly from Codex. Every tool is read-only: agents read, analyze and explain, people approve in the Trio App.
defaultPrompt: Which payments over R$ 50 thousand went out this week?
How much have we spent on the marketing card this month?

positive.expected_behavior: Return the available balance per account grouped by entity, with a consolidated total in BRL.

positive.description: Large outgoing payments in a period
positive.prompt: Which payments over R$ 50 thousand went out this week?
positive.expected_behavior: List this week's settled outgoing payments above R$ 50,000.00 with payee, amount and status, walking every page.

positive.prompt: Did the Pix I was expecting arrive?
positive.expected_behavior: Report whether the incoming payment settled, with amount, payer and status; say what was searched if nothing is found.

positive.prompt: Who owns the Pix key finance@acme.com.br?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the key holder's name, institution and account type as registered, without creating any payment.

positive.prompt: How much have we spent on the marketing card this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Total this month's confirmed purchases on the marketing card in BRL, separating denied or reversed purchases.

negative.prompt: Pay this boleto for me now.
Show me the balances of another company.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only reads an existing Trio account; payments are created and approved in the Trio App.
